tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Search Brandfetch's index of 50M+ companies by brand name or domain. Returns each match's canonical domain, logo URL and brand profile URL. Use it to turn a company name into the domain that every other tool and Brandfetch API takes.

query.description: A company name or domain, such as "Shopify" or "shopify.com".

limit.description: How many matches to return. Defaults to 5.
